name: Pigmalion's Angel
source:
A game in which you date an angel and need to increase your love bar with her and give her gifts and find some way to unlock the door at the end of the hallway.

[Edited from [url=https://kuraishimi.itch.io/secret-game-cancelled-in-2002]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这款游戏中，你和一位天使约会，需要增加你对她的爱，给她礼物，并找到某种方法打开走廊尽头的门。

[编辑自[url=https://kuraishimi.itch.io/secret-game-cancelled-in-2002]itch.io[/url]]
